Its partial trace on the fresh register is I9, proving the Markov extension for every x in Mat9, hence for the prefix TL algebra.
markov.capacity_scope: At SU(2)_4, the full positive Markov trace on the semisimple Jones quotient is represented by normalized ordinary matrix trace only in dimensions divisible by3^floor(n/2); the minimum is attained with the recorded quantum-dimension multiplicities. This does not bound arbitrary fixed-charge braid representations or the cost of a local R-matrix realization.
markov.prior: SU(2)_4 fusion and localization are classical (Rowell-Wang). Native TL generators and f4 are previous repository results. Here the explicit trace failure and fresh-register repair are checked on those actual matrices.

spectral.fundamental_obstruction: On C9 the faithful Mat9 left action has scalar commutant. No antiunitary J can make J Mat9 J^-1 commute with all Mat9; the order-zero reality condition fails on that carrier.

spectral.bimodule_dimension_reason: Commuting faithful left/right Mat9 actions give a nonzero representation of Mat9 tensor Mat9^op =Mat81. Thus its dimension is a multiple of81; the Hilbert-Schmidt module attains the minimum. This operator module is not automatically the different Steinberg81 homology representation.

spectral.even_grading_obstruction: Any grading commuting with all L_a is a right multiplication. Anticommuting it with L_H-R_H would force L_H to be a right multiplication, hence H scalar. The chosen nonconstant parent therefore admits no such even grading.
spectral.boundary: Explicit finite real first-order operator data, not a completed orientable/Poincare-dual spectral triple of the Standard Model, not even KO6 matter geometry, not Lorentzian gravity. The spectral action alone cannot select among these810 conjugate parents.
